## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

Tests (SDPA FROST paged forward)

## Summary

Two `pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match=...)` checks in `test_sdpa_fwd_paged_sm100.py` now match the current Rubin paged-KV decline text: `"Rubin paged KV serves half THD queries, MXFP8 pools on D128/D256"`. The decline behavior is unchanged.

## Why

- #1543 (46786f137) widened the message in `python/cudnn/sdpa/fwd/api_dsl.py` to `"Rubin paged KV serves half THD queries, MXFP8 pools on D128/D256, and decode-shaped half D256 graphs on the decode tile (...)"`.
- The tests still expected `"... half THD queries and MXFP8 pools"`.
- In develop schedule 72889881, three sdpa/frost lanes fail on the same four cases: `cutlass-rel:sm100`, `cutlass-4.8:sm100` and `cutlass-rel:sm103`. The four cases are:
  - `test_paged_adapter_declines_sm107_device[f16]`
  - `test_paged_adapter_declines_sm107_device[fp8]`
  - `test_paged_mxfp8_adapter_sm107_device_contract[d192x128]`
  - `test_paged_mxfp8_adapter_sm107_device_contract[d512]`
- The previous schedule (72675160) passed these lanes.

## Testing

On B200 with cuDNN 9.27, I ran `pytest -o addopts= -m "L0 or L1 or L2 or L3 or L4" -k sm107 sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_paged_sm100.py`. These tests mock an SM107 device on the real SM100.

| Tree | Result |
|---|---|
| develop's test file | 4 failed, 8 passed (the four CI failures above) |
| this PR | 12 passed |
